Chapter 7 - Classes and Methods / CyberProgressPartExtension

ICyberProgressPartExtension

Initializes this CyberProgressPartExtension object. 
void ICyberProgressPartExtension (in ODPart basePart);
basePart
The OpenDoc part extended by this object.
DISCUSSION
You should call the ICyberProgressPartExtension method to initialize a newly created CyberProgressPartExtension object.

If you subclass CyberProgressPartExtension and override this method, your override must call its inherited method.
